hints.title: Derive Grid Dimensions
hints.text: Divide the total encoded text length by the number of rows to find the column count.

hints.title: Diagonal Coordinate Stepping
hints.text: Follow diagonals starting at the first row, incrementing row and column index simultaneously.

hints.title: Remove Trailing Spaces
hints.text: Accumulate characters and remove any trailing space padding from the decoded result.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) where N is length of encoded text
complexity.notes: Direct 1D coordinate calculation r * cols + c + r decodes diagonals without creating a 2D matrix.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Allocating full 2D string matrices adds memory allocations and copying overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct arithmetic mapping produces decoded stream in optimal linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should strip trailing spaces from the reconstructed message.
